Comment: Send alert to PagerDuty Events API v2

Check_Routing_Key.Comment: Only send if routing key is configured

Build_Alert_Payload.Comment: Prepare PagerDuty payload with truncated error and AWS Console links
Build_Alert_Payload.Output: {% ( $summary := 'Task ' & $states.input.task_name & ' FAILED in ' & ($exists($states.input.pipeline_name) ? $states.input.pipeline_name : 'unknown'); $errorShort := $exists($states.input.error) ? $substring($string($states.input.error), 0, 500) : 'No error details'; $severity := $exists($states.input.severity) ? $states.input.severity : 'critical'; $awsConsole := 'https://${aws_region}.console.aws.amazon.com/states/home?region=${aws_region}#/v2/executions/details/'; $taskArn := $exists($states.input.task_execution_arn) and $states.input.task_execution_arn != '' ? $states.input.task_execution_arn : ''; $wrapperArn := $exists($states.input.wrapper_execution_arn) and $states.input.wrapper_execution_arn != '' ? $states.input.wrapper_execution_arn : ''; $taskLink := $taskArn != '' ? [{'href': $awsConsole & $taskArn, 'text': 'Task SFN Execution'}] : []; $wrapperLink := $wrapperArn != '' ? [{'href': $awsConsole & $wrapperArn, 'text': 'Wrapper SFN Execution'}] : []; $uiUrl := '${ui_url}'; $uiLink := $uiUrl != '' ? [{'href': $uiUrl & '/?pipeline=' & $states.input.pipeline_name & '&task=' & $states.input.task_name & '&date=' & $states.input.date, 'text': 'SLSFlow Console'}] : []; $links := $append($append($uiLink, $taskLink), $wrapperLink); { 'original': $states.input, 'pagerduty': { 'routing_key': '${pagerduty_routing_key}', 'event_action': 'trigger', 'dedup_key': $states.input.pipeline_name & '/' & $states.input.task_name & '/' & $states.input.date, 'payload': { 'summary': $summary, 'severity': $severity, 'source': 'slsflow', 'timestamp': $now(), 'custom_details': { 'pipeline': $exists($states.input.pipeline_name) ? $states.input.pipeline_name : 'unknown', 'task': $states.input.task_name, 'execution': $states.input.execution_name, 'date': $exists($states.input.date) ? $states.input.date : '', 'error': $errorShort, 'console_url': '${console_url}' } }, 'links': $links } } ) %}
